query: SELECT 'location' AS "kind!: String", name AS "name!: String", EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM object_reviewed WHERE kind = 'location' AND object_id = location.id) AS "reviewed!: bool" FROM location WHERE world_id = ?1 AND deleted = 0 UNION ALL SELECT 'connection', origin.name || ' -> ' || target.name, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM object_reviewed WHERE kind = 'connection' AND object_id = connection.id) FROM connection JOIN location AS origin ON origin.id = connection.from_location_id JOIN location AS target ON target.id = connection.to_location_id WHERE connection.world_id = ?1 AND connection.deleted = 0 UNION ALL SELECT 'group', name, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM object_reviewed WHERE kind = 'group' AND object_id = "group".id) FROM "group" WHERE world_id = ?1 AND deleted = 0 UNION ALL SELECT 'npc', name, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM object_reviewed WHERE kind = 'npc' AND object_id = character.id) FROM character WHERE world_id = ?1 AND role = 'npc' AND deleted = 0 UNION ALL SELECT 'item_type', name, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM object_reviewed WHERE kind = 'item_type' AND object_id = item_type.id) FROM item_type WHERE world_id = ?1 AND deleted = 0 UNION ALL SELECT 'item', name, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM object_reviewed WHERE kind = 'item' AND object_id = item.id) FROM item JOIN item_location ON item_location.item_id = item.id WHERE world_id = ?1 AND item.deleted = 0
